title: Activate the EU TDM reservation by mirroring to an owned domain

completion_criteria.text: Establish what a valid EU Art. 4(3) machine-readable reservation actually requires, and whether self-hosting satisfies it, rather than assuming a mirror is the answer
Decide domain, host and sync mechanism on real numbers - one-off and recurring cost, effort, failure modes - with doing nothing costed honestly as a live option
Serve robots.txt, ai.txt and /.well-known/tdmrep.json from the owned domain, each verified by fetching it over the public internet at its expected path
Keep the mirror from drifting from the repo, with a sync that fails loudly rather than silently serving stale terms
Confirm the reservation is machine-discoverable: correct content types, tdmrep.json valid against its schema, and the canonical location declared from the repo

spine.active_goal: Make the AI-training reservation actually operative, rather than merely committed to the repo, by serving it from a domain we control - or establish on evidence that this is not worth doing.
spine.next_step: Start at c1 and do not skip it: the mirror is the assumed answer, not a verified one. Establish what Art. 4(3) requires of a machine-readable reservation, whether a self-hosted copy satisfies it, and whether major crawlers honour ai.txt and tdmrep.json at all in practice. Only then price the domain, host and sync. If c1 shows the mechanism does not deliver, closing this thread as abandoned with that finding is a legitimate outcome and better than building an inert mirror.
spine.last_session: Opened as successor to repo-licensing-polyform-noncommercial, which put the license and the machine-readable reservation on main but left them inert. No mirror work has been started.

open_risks.text: do not present the committed opt-out files as active protection — while the project is GitHub-hosted, crawlers fetch github.com/robots.txt and never the repository's copy, which is the entire reason this thread exists
do not let the mirror silently diverge from the repo — a mirror serving stale terms is worse than none, because it looks like a reservation while asserting the wrong thing

out_of_scope: Obtaining legal counsel or a legal opinion on whether the reservation binds a given crawler - this thread reports what the published rules and the observed crawler behavior say, and is not legal advice.
Revisiting the choice of PolyForm Noncommercial itself - that was settled on the predecessor thread and its rationale lives in decision 0332.
